title.ja: 図1-1 持駒の金と銀で必至をかけよう！
title.en: Figure 1-1: Apply a brinkmate with the gold and silver in hand!

explain.ja: 図1-1では、相手玉に守りの駒が一切ありません。持ち駒の金と銀を使って必至をかけるにはどうすればよいでしょうか。
explain.en: In Diagram 1-1 the enemy king has no defenders. How can you create a brinkmate using the gold and silver in hand?

section.ja: 詰めろの基本形!王手をかけずに相手玉を攻めよう
section.en: Basic form of a threat of mate: attack the king without giving check

title.ja: 図1-2 控て銀を打って必至
title.en: Figure 1-2: Drop the silver on the side for a brinkmate

explain.ja: 相手玉の1マス後ろから銀を打てば必至です。相手が何もしなければ▲5二金で詰みますが、相手はこの詰みを受けられません。
explain.en: Dropping the silver one square behind the king makes a brinkmate. If White does nothing, ▲5二金 mates, and White cannot defend against it.

section.ja: 相手玉の逃げ道をなくすのがコツ
section.en: The key is taking away the opponent king's escape routes

title.en: Figure 1-3: Checkmate with a head gold

explain.ja: 相手玉が逃げても頭金で詰みます。詰将棋の基本が頭金であるように、必至問題も基本は頭金を狙います。次に頭金で詰む形を目指すのが基本です。
explain.en: Even if the king runs, a head-gold mate follows. Just as the head gold is the basis of tsume, brinkmate problems are also based on aiming for a head-gold mate: aim for a shape where the next move is a head-gold mate.

section.ja: 何を指してきても頭金で詰み!
section.en: Whatever White plays, it is checkmate with a head gold!

title.ja: 図1-2 やっぱり頭金を目指そう
title.en: Figure 1-2: Aim for the head gold after all

explain.ja: 今度は持ち駒が飛車と金ですが、ここでも頭金を目指して必至をかけましょう。
explain.en: Now the pieces in hand are a rook and a gold, but again aim for a head-gold mate to make a brinkmate.

section.ja: 飛車を使って詰めろ、必至をかけよう!
section.en: Use the rook to make threats of mate and brinkmate!

title.ja: 図2-2 相手玉を上に逃がさないように
title.en: Figure 2-2: Keep the opposing king from escaping upward

explain.ja: ここでは飛車を二段目に打って必至です。次に相手玉がどこへ逃げても頭金で詰ませられます。実戦では一段目に飛車を打って王手しがちです。
explain.en: Here you drop the rook on the second rank for a brinkmate. Wherever the king goes next, a head-gold mate follows. In a real game you might tend to check by dropping the rook on the first rank.

section.ja: とにかく上に逃がさないように!
section.en: Above all, do not let it escape upward

title.ja: 図2-3 どこに逃げても頭金
title.en: Figure 2-3: Head gold wherever it escapes

explain.ja: 相手玉がどこへ逃げても頭金です。飛車の横利きが、玉が二段目へ逃げる手を防いでいます。初手に▲8二飛や▲7二飛といった手でも必至になります。
explain.en: Wherever the king goes, it is a head-gold mate. The rook's sideways control prevents the king from escaping onto the second rank. Moves such as ▲8二飛 or ▲7二飛 also make a brinkmate.

section.en: The opponent's king has no defense

title.ja: 図3-1 盤上に相手の駒が
title.en: Figure 3-1: There is an opposing piece on the board

explain.ja: 今度は盤上に相手の駒がある場合を見ます。考えることは増えますが、基本の考え方は同じです。
explain.en: Now consider the case where enemy pieces are on the board. There is more to think about, but the basic idea is the same.

section.ja: 相手の盤面に駒がある場合は?相手の手を読んで必至を!
section.en: When the opponent has pieces on the board? Read their moves and apply brinkmate

title.ja: 図3-2 やはりいつもの形

explain.ja: やはり▲2三銀と、相手玉の後ろから駒を打つ手が正解です。相手が何もしなければ▲1二金で詰みですが、どのように受けても次に詰むことを確認しましょう。相手の手をしっかり読んで、必至になっていることを確かめます。
explain.en: Again ▲2三銀, dropping a piece behind the king, is correct. If White does nothing, ▲1二金 mates; confirm that however White defends, a mate follows. Read the opponent's replies carefully to verify it is a brinkmate.

title.ja: 図3-3 銀で受けてきたら▲3二金
title.en: Figure 3-3: If they defend with a silver, ▲3二金

explain.ja: 相手が銀で受けてきても、今度は▲3二金から詰みます。△1一玉と逃げても、▲2二金と銀を取って詰みです。相手が△2二銀でなく△3二銀と受けてきたら、▲2二金の頭金です。
explain.en: If White defends with a silver, ▲3二金 mates. Even if the king escapes with △1一玉, ▲2二金 capturing the silver is mate. If White defends with △3二銀 instead of △2二銀, ▲2二金 is a head-gold mate.

section.en: Even if defended with the silver...

title.ja: 図4-1 相手の持ち駒に注意
title.en: Figure 4-1: Watch out for the opponent's pieces in hand

explain.ja: 最後は相手が持ち駒を持っている場合を見ます。金銀桂の3枚の駒を使って必至をかけましょう。
explain.en: Finally, look at the case where the opponent has pieces in hand. Make a brinkmate using the gold, silver and knight.

section.ja: 相手に持ち駒がある場合の必至の形
section.en: Brinkmate shape when the opponent has pieces in hand

title.ja: 図4-2 とにかくこの形！
title.en: Figure 4-2: In any case, this shape!

explain.ja: とにかく、銀を1マス後ろから打つ形を覚えておきましょう。相手が持ち駒の金をどう使っても必至がかかります。
explain.en: Remember the shape of dropping the silver one square behind the king. However the opponent uses the gold in hand, the brinkmate holds.

section.ja: とにかくこの形を覚えよう!

title.ja: 図4-3 桂馬を打って詰み
title.en: Figure 4-3: Checkmate by dropping a knight

explain.ja: ▲2二金の頭金で詰まされるのを警戒して、△3一金と受けてきました。しかしこれには▲3三桂と桂馬で王手すれば詰みです。玉の逃げ道がないのがポイントで、つるし桂という形です。
explain.en: White guards against the ▲2二金 head-gold mate with △3一金. But ▲3三桂 giving check with the knight is mate, since the king has no escape; this is a hanging knight (tsurushi-keima) shape.

section.en: What if the opponent defends from below?

title.ja: 図4-4 これでも桂打ちで詰む
title.en: Figure 4-4: Even so, a knight drop is checkmate

explain.ja: 今度は図4-2から△2二金と受けてきましたが、これにも▲3三桂から詰みます。もし相手が△同金と取れば、▲2二金の頭金で詰みです。
explain.en: This time White defends with △2二金 from Diagram 4-2, but ▲3三桂 mates this as well. If White takes with △同金, ▲2二金 is a head-gold mate.

title.ja: 図4-5 逃げても金で詰み
title.en: Figure 4-5: Even if it escapes, checkmate with the gold

explain.ja: 相手玉が逃げても、横から金を打てば詰みです。桂馬がよく利いていて、相手に逃げ場所がありません。
explain.en: Even if the king runs, dropping a gold from the side mates. The knight covers well and the opponent has no escape square.
